correctness.rationale: The dimension-four addition formula gives a 25-by-25 C5xC5-circulant Chebyshev U_ell Gram matrix. Fourier diagonalization yields the exact rank sequence 1,4,8,16,21,25,24 at ell=0..6, unique degree-six zero eigenvalue at (0,0), and rank 25 for ell=7..47. The package exact Q(sqrt 5) arithmetic and an independent Fourier matrix/rank calculation corroborate the finite range. For all ell>=48, every off-diagonal |U_ell(dot)|<2 because |dot|<sqrt(3)/2; 24 off-diagonal entries have total abs sum<48, whereas diagonal ell+1>=49. Strict diagonal dominance proves invertibility on the infinite tail, not merely extrapolation of finite testing. The harmonic character average and Legendre P_3(0)=0 identify the exact degree-six mean-zero image.
